{{Quote|There he is...|Commander of the 501st Legion|<ref name="SWBII" />}}
A '''male Human Jedi Master''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Constructing a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] imbued with green [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] at its core, this Master was proficient in it use during [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. During his years of service to the Order, the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] went to war, drawing the Jedi Order into the conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Master was stationed at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the Republic betrayed the Order by issuing [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] marched on the Jedi Temple and began to slaughter all of its occupants, Masters, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]], and [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] alike.<ref name="SWBII" />

As the forces of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] stormed the Temple as part of [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], this man came to possess a valuable [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and attempted to escape the Temple with the [[Jedi artifact/Legends|artifact]]. While putting up a fight, this Master was slain by Darth Vader during the fighting and the holocron fell into the hands of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="SWBII" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Jedi Master is killed by the player in ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', but the means of his execution is not standardized. He can be killed either as Vader or a clone trooper at the whim of the player.

The nature of the holocron is not disclosed in the game, but the way the 501st leader reacts to finding the Jedi make it appear quite important to the emerging [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
